user_case.origin: Representative location near NTU from screenshots; exact GPS was not provided
user_case.historical_replay_limit: The original live arrivals and exact GPS coordinates are unavailable; no claim of reproducing the original screenshot exactly.

findings.issue: Shared interchange exits were attached only to one line code
findings.fix: Resolve missing entrances through explicit same-name indoor transfers within 400m; keep raw map exits unique.
findings.limit: The old center also passed pedestrian endpoint validation in this case. The missing exits alone do not explain the missing MRT screenshot.

findings.issue: Preview selection canceled ongoing verification of alternatives
findings.fix: Continue discovery while preserving the inspected route and map; cancel when starting navigation or leaving the journey.

findings.issue: YouBike counts arriving after the initial search were not considered
findings.fix: Search counts during planning even with the bike layer hidden and add verified connectors without resetting the inspected journey.

findings.issue: Empty nearby bicycle stations exhausted the station search budget
findings.fix: Filter current supply within the walking radius before limiting candidate pairs.

findings.issue: Bike connectors were limited by the first transit families and treated as walking in preference penalties
findings.fix: Compare connection savings across candidate families, verify real cycling routes, and separate walking preference cost from cycling while retaining all elapsed travel time.

measured_pedestrian_case.note: Real Apple pedestrian paths; timetable-based train wait, not historical official realtime.
